en: Beyond this door wait the Elite Four. Only a trainer who has won every Badge of Hoenn may pass.
Every one of them! Go forth, challenger, and may your Pokémon carry you through.
You haven't won every Badge of Hoenn yet. We can't let you through. Come back once you have them all.
Go forth, challenger. The Elite Four are waiting.
Welcome! Stock up well. Once you go through that door, there's no coming back to buy more.
